entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fault. The pulse sensor is completely inaccurate. I've been a loyal VeloFit user for years, and I'm just so disappointed. This thing is basically garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear about the trouble with the pulse tracking. I can imagine how frustrating that must be. Our technical support team is excellent and can usually resolve this with a quick reset or a software patch. Would you be open to me transferring you?

No... honestly, I don't have time for all that. I'm just so let down. I saved up for this, and it doesn't even work. At this point, I just want my money back. I really need that for other bills right now.

I understand you're frustrated and you just want a simple solution. You're looking for a refund, and you don't want to go through troubleshooting. Let me pull up your account and check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I have your order here. I see the VeloBand was delivered about 40 days ago. Let me just check our policy... Okay, yes. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So you can help me?
Yes. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and approve this return immediately. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now.
Wow, that's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was really worried I'd be stuck with it. I really appreciate this.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Once our warehouse receives the item, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
